references.text: Machir is mentioned as the son of Manasseh, and his descendants had children who were born on Joseph's knees, indicating the lineage that later settled in Gilead.
Moses gave Gilead to Machir, confirming the conquest described in Numbers 32:39.
Describes Machir as the firstborn of Manasseh and father of Gilead, noting he was a warrior who received Gilead and Bashan.
Half of Gilead was given to Machir's descendants, completing the account of their conquest.
The lineage of the Machirites descends from Machir, and from Machir came Gilead and the lineage of the Gileadites.
Mentions Machir as the son of Manasseh in the genealogy of Zelophehad's daughters, linking to the region of Gilead.
Describes Machir as father of Gilead and his descendants' settlements, including the conquest of villages in the Gilead area.
Machir's son Gilead is mentioned, confirming the lineage and connection to the region of Gilead.
